description: Deep into jazz-rooted hip-hop: sample-flipped, head-nod boom-bap with real digging. Hates playlist-filler lo-fi. STRUCTURAL DRAFT — tweak the details.
notes: Focused single-lane profile: the test is subtlety WITHIN jazz-hip-hop (canon vs filler, digging depth, mood), plus one clean novel bridge out of the lane. Edit freely — the golden set (eval/golden/jazzy_hiphop.json) is the answer key and every entry in it must be inferable from these reviews.

reviews.text: Melancholy head-nod. Perfect loops, real jazz chops under the rap. Makes me want to write stuff.
Common is cheesy as always, but great beats and vibes
